texts.text: About ISACA

texts.label: text
texts.orig: For more than 50 years, ISACA ®  ( www.isaca.org ) has advanced the best talent, expertise and learning in technology. ISACA equips individuals with knowledge, credentials, education and community to progress their careers and transform their organizations, and enables enterprises to train and build quality teams. Among those credentials, ISACA advances and validates business-critical skills and knowledge through the globally respected Certified Information Systems Auditor ®  (CISA ® ), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control ®  (CRISC ® ), Certified Information Security Manager ®  (CISM ® ), Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT ®  (CGEIT ® ) and Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer ™  (CDPSE ™ ) credentials. ISACA is a global professional association and learning organization that leverages the expertise of its 145,000 members who work in information security, governance, assurance, risk and privacy to drive innovation through technology. It has a presence in 188 countries, including more than 220 chapters worldwide.

texts.orig: ISACA is pleased to offer the sixteenth edition of the CISM ®  Review Manual . The purpose of the manual is to provide CISM candidates with information and references to assist in the preparation and study for the Certified Information Security Manager ®  (CISM) exam.
texts.text: ISACA is pleased to offer the sixteenth edition of the CISM ®  Review Manual . The purpose of the manual is to provide CISM candidates with information and references to assist in the preparation and study for the Certified Information Security Manager ®  (CISM) exam.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The CISM ®  Review Manual is updated regularly to keep pace with rapid changes in the management of information security. As with previous manuals, the sixteenth edition is the result of contributions from many qualified authorities who have generously volunteered their time and expertise. We respect and appreciate their contributions and hope their efforts provide extensive educational value to CISM manual readers.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The sample questions contained in this manual are designed to depict the types of questions typically found on the CISM exam and to give further clarity to the content presented in this manual. The CISM exam is a practice-based exam. Simply reading the reference material in this manual will not properly prepare candidates for the exam. The self-assessment questions are included for guidance only. Scoring results do not indicate future individual exam success.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: An international job practice analysis is conducted periodically to maintain the validity of the CISM certification program. A new job practice forms the basis of the CISM exam beginning in 2022.
texts.text: An international job practice analysis is conducted periodically to maintain the validity of the CISM certification program. A new job practice forms the basis of the CISM exam beginning in 2022.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The primary focus areas of the job practice are the current tasks performed and the knowledge used by CISMs. By gathering evidence of the current work practice of CISMs, ISACA ensures that the CISM program continues to meet the high standards set for the certification of professionals throughout the world.

texts.orig: Overview
texts.text: Overview

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The CISM ®  Review Manual 16th Edition is a reference guide designed to assist candidates in preparing for the CISM examination. The manual is one source of preparation for the exam but should not be thought of as the only source or viewed as a comprehensive collection of all the information and experience required to pass the exam. No single publication offers such coverage and detail.
texts.text: The CISM ®  Review Manual 16th Edition is a reference guide designed to assist candidates in preparing for the CISM examination. The manual is one source of preparation for the exam but should not be thought of as the only source or viewed as a comprehensive collection of all the information and experience required to pass the exam. No single publication offers such coverage and detail.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: As candidates read the manual and encounter topics that are new to them or ones in which they feel their knowledge and experience are limited, additional references should be sought. The examination will be composed of questions testing the candidate's technical and practical knowledge, and ability to apply the knowledge (based on experience) in given situations.

texts.orig: Preparing for the CISM Exam
texts.text: Preparing for the CISM Exam

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The CISM exam evaluates a candidate's practical knowledge based on experiences and application of the job practice domains as described in this review manual. We recommend that the candidate look to multiple resources to prepare for the exam, including this review manual and external publications. This section includes some tips for studying for the exam.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Actual exam questions test the candidate's practical application of relevant knowledge. At the end of each chapter, a sample self-assessment, consisting of questions, answers and explanations, introduces the question structure and general content. Remember that the sample questions may not be similar to questions appearing on the actual exam. Use reference material to find other publications that offer more detailed information on the topics addressed in this manual.

texts.orig: Getting Started
texts.text: Getting Started

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Having adequate time to prepare for the CISM exam is critical. Most candidates spend between three and six months studying prior to taking the exam. Set aside a designated time each week to study, and perhaps increase study time as the exam date approaches. It helps to develop a study plan for preparing for the exam.

texts.orig: Types of Questions on the CISM Exam
texts.text: Types of Questions on the CISM Exam

texts.label: text
texts.orig: CISM exam questions are developed with the intent of measuring and testing practical knowledge and the application of information security management principles. All questions are presented in a multiplechoice format and are designed to elicit one best answer.
texts.text: CISM exam questions are developed with the intent of measuring and testing practical knowledge and the application of information security management principles. All questions are presented in a multiplechoice format and are designed to elicit one best answer.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The candidate is cautioned to read each question carefully. Knowing that these types of questions are asked will go a long way toward answering them correctly. The best answer is one of the choices provided. There can be many potential solutions to the problems posed in the scenarios, depending on industry, geographical location, etc. It is advisable to consider the information provided in the question and to determine the best answer among the options provided.

The best answer is one of the choices provided. There can be many potential solutions to the problems posed in the scenarios, depending on industry, geographical location, etc. It is advisable to consider the information provided in the question and to determine the best answer among the options provided.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Each CISM question has a stem (question) and four options (answer choices). The candidate is asked to choose the correct or best answer from the options. The stem may be in the form of a question or incomplete statement. In some instances, a scenario or description may be included. These questions normally describe a situation and require the candidate to answer two or more questions based on the information provided.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Preparing for the Exam
texts.text: Preparing for the Exam

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When preparing for the exam, the candidate should recognize that information security is a global profession, and the candidate's perceptions and experiences may not reflect the global position. Because the exam and CISM manuals are written for the international information security management community, the candidate must be flexible when reading about a condition that may contradict the candidate's experience.
texts.text: When preparing for the exam, the candidate should recognize that information security is a global profession, and the candidate's perceptions and experiences may not reflect the global position. Because the exam and CISM manuals are written for the international information security management community, the candidate must be flexible when reading about a condition that may contradict the candidate's experience.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Note that the CISM exam questions are written by experienced information security professionals from around the world. Each question on the exam is reviewed by ISACA's CISM Exam Item Development Working Group, which consists of international members. This geographic representation ensures that all exam questions are understood equally well in every country and language.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: CISM exam questions are developed with the intent of measuring and testing practical knowledge in information security management. All questions are multiple choice and are designed for one best answer. Every CISM question has a stem (question) and four options (answer choices). The candidate is asked to choose the correct or best answer from the options. The stem may be in the form of a question or incomplete statement. Many times, a CISM examination question will require the candidate to choose the most likely or best answer.

table_cells.text: The overview provides the context of the domain, including job practice areas, applicable learning objectives and task statements.

Because many of the concepts presented within the review manual are complex, candidates may find it useful to refer to external sources to supplement their understanding of those concepts. The suggested references for each chapter are resources to help enhance study efforts.

The self-assessment questions in each chapter are not intended to measure the candidate's ability to answer questions correctly on the CISM exam for that area. The questions are intended to familiarize the candidate with question structure, and they may or may not be similar to questions that appear on the actual examination.

The glossary included at the end of the manual contains terms that apply to: The material included in the chapters  Related areas not specifically discussed in the manual  Since the glossary is an extension of the manual text, it can point to areas the candidate may want to explore further using additional references.
